summary: An NFO future, Quote then Depth on the same client: 5paisa streams no OI on MarketFeedV3, so oi is left out (an OI-only frame makes nothing); adding Depth subscribes MarketDepthService alone, the book carries the latest quote, a new quote frame still reaches the Quote subscription, and dropping Depth unsubscribes only the book.

notes: Frames worked here in 5paisa's MarketFeedV3 and MarketDepthService shapes. The OI-only frame stands for any frame with neither LastRate nor Details: both sides publish nothing from it (_on_data target_modes ()). Its field names are illustrative; neither side subscribes 5paisa's OI method.

deviations.reason: The desktop sends 5paisa's best bid and ask in Depth too, from the latest quote: feed/dialect/names.rs sends a web key from the mode the web adapter first sends it in (Quote) and every mode above it, so a script never meets a KeyError on the richer frame; the 5paisa web adapter's Depth dict has no bid or ask. Pending the lead's approval of that rule.

deviations.reason: The desktop sends price_change on an equity or a future (ltp less the previous close: feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends ChgPcnt as percent_change only, which the desktop sends too. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.

The desktop sends price_change_percent (5paisa's ChgPcnt) on an equity or a future beside percent_change (feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends percent_change only. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.
